card.name: Words just before "to" in comparisons
card.fires_on: Words that come right before "to" in a comparison or range, such as comparable, equal, "up" and "the time" in "up to the time of". It is seen in dose and exposure comparisons and in general prose.

modes.label: Comparable or equal to
modes.description: The word comparable or equal, or a piece of it, right before "to" when matching one amount to another.
modes.example: exposures approximately<< equal>> to the human exposure at the recommended dose

modes.label: Up to the time of
modes.description: The word time after "up to the" or "around the", leading into "of" or "that".
modes.example: any day up to the<< time>> of the next scheduled weekly dose.

modes.label: Up to in ranges
modes.description: The word up before "to" in a concentration or amount range.

card.plain: It marks a word that sets up a comparison or limit, where "to" usually comes next.
